remarks: MUST SEE!!! SPACIOUS & beautifully appointed farmhouse colonial comfortably set on 2.23 gorgeous acres in the Town of Marilla; move-in ready with highly rated Iroquois schools & captivating countryside views with incredible privacy. Step through the elegant covered front door entryway and into the cozy formal living room with a built-in wood stove insert with brick surround and Bamboo hardwood flooring throughout. This open-concept home flows seamlessly from the dining room with bright windows for an abundance of natural light and into the gorgeously renovated, eat-in kitchen with Granite counters, wood cabinetry, breakfast bar, and recessed lighting. The family room features soaring cathedral ceilings, gas fireplace with custom white mantel, ample space for entertaining and a sliding glass door leading to the expansive wood deck for enjoying the peaceful scenic views while sipping your morning coffee, enhanced by landscape boulders lining the driveway & fruit trees. Upstairs features a master suite with vaulted ceilings, walk in closet, and an ensuite bathroom with tile flooring, dual vanity, jetted soaking tub and a tile shower surround with accent strip. Two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the upstairs, while the office space on the 1st floor could be that additional bedroom, and 1st floor laundry & multiple closets adorned with California Closets make for ease of living. The massive and skillfully re-structured 30'x56' barn with a metal roof and metal siding has a steel beam track for equipment loading, hay loft, all new windows and overhead doors which is a dream. Impeccably kept w/luxurious finishes, this desirable home has tasteful updates including paint, landscaping, partial basement drain tile 2026, Bradford White HWT 2026, high-efficiency Trane furnace 2024, whole house Generac generator & A/C 2019, fireplace 2018, industrial grade sump w/secondary sump installed 2026, and kitchen in 2016. No expense spared on this captivating home with low taxes, great schools & close to all conveniences. Sq footage from owner and showings start 9/2/26.
